subpages.text: Skip to content Call: 22 57 30 57 Main Menu The Company Products Projects Contact Search Home Projects Bank of Cyprus shops and COOP Bank shops Bank of Cyprus shops and COOP Bank shops The Closed Circuit Television Systems, Access Control, Burglar Alarm and Fire Alarm Systems at various Bank of Cyprus shops and COOP Bank shops. Wave Electronics is one major supplier and installer of Security Systems for the Bank of Cyprus. These systems are installed and maintained in many Bank shops throughout Cyprus. The need for high security is the critical factor in deciding which and how a system should be installed whether a CCTV, Entrance Control, Burglar Alarm or Fire Alarm system. For the same reasons Wave Electronics was chosen by COOP Bank to secure a number of shops against possible unauthorized entry, theft or fires.
